column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3: So you've come\nto Tolbi after all.{page_break}Still chasing answers,\nIsaac?{end_wait}
What do you want?\nYou said enough\nin Lamakan.{end_wait}
The next beacon\nwill burn, too.{page_break}I think the Wise One\nis counting on it.{end_wait}
You said your world\nwas destroyed.\nWhy believe you?{end_wait}
You don't have to\nbelieve me, Garet.\nJust keep watching.{end_wait}
You came to scare us.\nWe're not giving up.{end_wait}
You were so angry\nwhen that beast fell,\nweren't you, Mia?{end_wait}
I was angry.\nI won't deny it.\nBut I'm not like you.{end_wait}
Keep going, Isaac.\nThe next lighthouse\nis waiting.{end_wait}
